attempts.plan: The legacy code has multiple bugs: (1) `DateUtil` uses lenient `SimpleDateFormat` allowing impossible dates like 2026-02-30, (2) `HolidayTable` is missing Epiphany (6 Jan) holiday, (3) `LegacyPaymentCalendar` uses server default time zone instead of Warsaw for cut-off determination, (4) `daysLate` uses fixed 24h milliseconds ignoring DST, (5) `addMonths` doesn't follow month-end rules, (6) static `SimpleDateFormat` fields cause concurrency failures. I'll rewrite `DateUtil` and `LegacyPaymentCalendar` to use `java.time` with Warsaw time, fix `HolidayTable` to include 6 Jan, and ensure thread safety.
